steps.clueRiddle:
Three hours east with a big river beside us.
Games, bingo and French words will guide us.
steps.clueReveal: We drive from Kingston to Montréal today. Play all three car games on the way. The animal quiz will help you this afternoon!

challenges.title: Animal Trivia Deck
challenges.instructions: Answer questions about amazing animals. One big question at a time. Some of them are waiting for you today!

challenges.title: St. Lawrence Bingo
challenges.instructions: Watch for each thing out the window. Tap a square when you spot it. Four in a row is bingo.

challenges.title: First French Words
challenges.instructions: Flip the cards and say each word out loud. Then match the French to the English. Three words will get you far today.

steps.funFact: The moment you cross into Québec, every road sign switches to French.

steps.clueRiddle:
Halfway there, a warm café by the river.
Count from the car, or search inside — you pick!
steps.clueReveal: Stop at Tilly's Eatery on Pitt Street. This is a Detour: pick Count or Search. Both work fine in the rain.

a.label: Count
a.blurb: Count from your seat in the car. Cozy, dry and sharp-eyed.

challenges.title: River Road Count
challenges.instructions: Count boats, bridges and transport trucks. Watch the river side of the road. Add up your grand total.

b.label: Search
b.blurb: Hunt inside the warm café. Hot chocolate optional.

challenges.title: Café Search
challenges.instructions: Look around inside Tilly's. Find all five things on the list. Tap each one to check it off.
checklist: A French word on a sign

steps.funFact: The St. Lawrence River carries ships all the way from the ocean to Lake Superior.

steps.clueRiddle:
Five whole worlds are hiding under one roof.
Penguins waddle here — go find the proof.
steps.clueReveal: Who's the animal expert? Drive straight to the Biodôme at Olympic Park. Hunt for five animals inside.

challenges.title: Ecosystem Hunt
challenges.instructions: Walk through all five ecosystems. Find each animal on the list. The sloth is the hardest — he hides!
checklist: A fish bigger than your head
A bird with a long beak

challenges.title: Animal Expert Test
challenges.instructions: Three questions about the animals here. Read the signs if you need help. Then tap your answer.

trivia.q: How many ecosystems does the Biodôme have?
trivia.funFact: Each ecosystem has its own temperature, plants and animals.

trivia.q: Why is a sloth so hard to spot?
choices: It moves very slowly and hides high up
It only comes out in winter
trivia.funFact: Sloths move so slowly that green algae can grow on their fur.

trivia.q: Where do penguins live in the wild?
choices: The far south, not the Arctic
trivia.funFact: Penguins and polar bears never meet — they live at opposite ends.

steps.funFact: The Biodôme building was the cycling track for the 1976 Montréal Olympics.

steps.clueRiddle:
Aisles and carts and a list in your hand.
Tonight's dinner is hiding — go find it fast!
steps.clueReveal: On the drive back, stop at the Provigo near the Bell Centre. Find six dinner ingredients on your list.

challenges.title: Supermarket Sweep
challenges.instructions: Find each grocery item on the list. Put it in the cart. Tap to check it off.

steps.funFact: In Québec, food packages must always show French words first.

steps.clueRiddle:
One little word opens every door in Québec.
Say it out loud to the person at the desk.
steps.clueReveal: Walk up to the hotel front desk. Say bonjour to the person working there. Smile — that is the whole challenge.

challenges.title: Say Bonjour
challenges.instructions: Read the phrase card out loud first. Then say it to the front desk person. Use a big, friendly voice.

steps.funFact: In Québec, people say bonjour when they arrive and bonsoir at night.

steps.clueRiddle:
Mackay Street is tonight's finish line.
Roll your bag to the mat — leg two is done.
steps.clueReveal: Check in at Hôtel Monroe on Rue Mackay. Find your suite and drop your bags. Then step onto the pit stop mat.
steps.funFact: Your suite has a kitchen, so tonight the team cooks dinner together.
